source.name: Full Bloom Aroma
source.originalDescription: The user emits a sweet aroma around themselves dealing damage to opposing Pokémon every 0.5s up to 10 times. Opposing Pokémon hit by this move have their damage reduced by 10% for 3s, the duration is refreshed on each hit. For up to 5s, the user's next move will be in full bloom, granting extra effects. Meganium gains 2700 energy per second instead of the usual 900. Hitting with moves grants 4500 energy. Buffs: 10% Movement Speed, 10% Max HP Shield
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Full Bloom Aroma は シールドを付与する、継続ダメージを与える。
